warnings.message: the token can't list acme/widget-shadow's secret names; check that these exist there: NPM_TOKEN

pushes to synced branches start these workflows in the shadow repo: .github/workflows/rel.yml; ghostbranch sync cancels them when the token has Actions write. To stop them for good, add this to their push-triggered jobs: if: github.event_name != 'push' || github.repository == 'acme/widget' (a job that already has an if: combines them: if: <existing> && (github.event_name != 'push' || github.repository == 'acme/widget'))
acme/widget-shadow is private, so its Actions minutes are billed
